sentences.en: I ran back towards the campsite to see what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我跑回露营地去看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Maybe we could open a little shop next to the campsite.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以在露营地旁边开个小店。

sentences.en: There's a small campsite on the lake's southern shore.
sentences.zh: 湖的南岸有一个小露营地。

senses.zh: 度假营地；野营地，宿营地
